def center(r,C): return (13+6*r, 12+6*C)
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    g=[]; sel=None; dest=None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
        if n['color']=='N':
            r=round((r0-18)/6)+1; C=round((c0-29)/6)+3
            g.append((r,C))
        elif n['color']=='G':
            sel=(round((r0-18)/6)+1, round((c0-29)/6)+3)
        elif n['color']=='g':
            dest=(round((r0-18)/6)+1, round((c0-29)/6)+3)
    return sorted(g), sel, dest
print("before:", state())

r,c = center(1,5)

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}], intent='explore')
print("after merge1:", state())
